title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My question is that recently one of our newphew died in car accident. And the mother of the newphew saw him in her dream without any clothes on his body and another relative saw in dream that one of his eye is missing. Kindly please explain me the meaning of this two dream. Thanks a lot. 1571 views Q. I want to know in detail about the practice of saying 'inshaallah'. Is it sunnah or compulsory, is there any punishment reported for not saying it, when have we been instructed to say it? 2057 views Q. I did Istekhara to marry a man who's shia but is ready to convert to sunni.I dreamed nice flames and bright red colour.After this i woke up n again when i went to sleep i had another dream in which i saw a man lying on something which looked like parallel electric cables in sky n some birds were around him maybe prodding at him.Also i think as if i was seeing it in a photo in a newspaper(about 2nd dream).What does the first dream interpret? Does these two dream are inter-related? Your guidance is highly appreciated. 1598 views Q. Asalamwalakum! i saw a dream this morning that i have many relatives at my house and they are just preparing for some function.i saw i am cooking chappatis in the kitchen on a big tawa. and my small cousin is helping me.he is trying to lit fire to the wood to cook food and tell him not to do so.then i saw i go to bathroom n take bath.then i saw i am going with a very fast speed and beside me one lady with 2 small kids is on one white horse and i felt that she was running from someone and trying to save her kids.on my way ahead i kept seeing many same kind women on white horses running.i later feel may be they are just idols or some picture but as i move on i saw few sikh men trying to learn how to ride a horse and then there is a big gate where that lane ends where they are practising.now i also feel that i was also riding a horse as i was moving with very fast speed!"Please help in understanding this Allah hafiz! 1739 views Q. Interpretation of dream 3336 views Q. Regarding dreaming hujur sallallahu alaihi wa sallam 1639 views Q. میں نے کہیں سنا ہے کہ اگر کوئی نئے شہر میں داخل ہو تو اسے اس شہر کی پیاز کھانی چاہئے ، 1040 views Q. My mother is searching a girl for me. So she zeroed on one girl who is Alima and all her family members are religious and follows sunnah. Now my mother has done Istikhara for one week, last two days she had dreams, 6th Day dream: My mohter saw two girls and two boys and one of the boy is my younger brother. 7th Day dream: My mother saw some male and female members in white clothes collectively performing zikr along with my Qala. Can you please interpret this dream and guide me further in this regard. 1612 views Q. Person seemingly having reverted to Islam in dream 5783 views Q. I would like to know about a dream that I had once. It was when I was about 12 years old and it should have been after sunrise sometime. I saw myself in the night in the hospital giving birth to a son, then I remember loving the son greatly and keeping him with me. After this, I gave him to my father to look after and when I came back looking for him, he was lost and I just saw flashes of him here and there; then I started crying in the dream and woke up. I felt very strange after waking up and became attached to the idea of motherhood. I think I need the meaning of this dream, jazak Allahu khair. 1357 views Q. 6 months back my friend has seen a 8-7 years old boy (who is rootless poor living on street type). 1288 views Q. I work in a software company here in India - Some days back, I saw in my dream my manager telling me to resign from the job(Lay off) after this dream I am perplexed as to what is this dream about- 1) Is it the indication I Should resgin from job 2) Is this dream Satan's whisper to cause distress 3) I am completely confused and I am praying Allah (Rabbul izzath) to guide me to the right path. Pls help in the interpretation of this dream. Jazakallah. 1467 views Q. Dream interpretation 1789 views Q. I have seen my self in a dream in makkah in front of the qabah sitting and looking at it, what does this mean? 2071 views Q. کیا امام ابن تیمیہ حق اسکالر تھے یا نہیں؟اور کیا عقیدہ اور توحید کے بارے میں ان کی کتاب مستند ہے یا نہیں؟ 1163 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 49010 Country: India Title: dream of seeing rauza sharif Question: I had a dream in which I saw the rauza sharif (grave of our bloved nabi s.a.w) twice. I ask u for this dream interpretation. Answer ID: 49010 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1730/1317/H=12/1434) You will be given taufiq by Allah to do good deeds and avoid sins. It is nice dream. You should follow sunnah in each matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
